subject.title: fix(openai): drop transient reasoning replay state

question: Should `rs_tmp_*` filtering apply to every Responses-compatible endpoint, or only to provider paths with a verified OpenAI transient-item contract?
rationale: The OpenAI reference requires manually managed reasoning items to be replayed but does not document the proposed prefix exception, while this shared package also serves compatible and proxied Responses paths.

options.title: Scope to verified contract
options.body: Require a provider or capability boundary plus real OpenAI evidence before dropping persisted reasoning items; this preserves compatibility for generic Responses endpoints.

options.title: Accept global prefix semantics
options.body: Apply the prefix rule to all compatible endpoints and explicitly accept that providers using durable `rs_tmp_*` IDs will lose replay state.

recommendation.title: Scope to verified contract
recommendation.body: Require a provider or capability boundary plus real OpenAI evidence before dropping persisted reasoning items; this preserves compatibility for generic Responses endpoints.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent provider replay work makes this the strongest available history-based routing candidate for the compatibility boundary.
